decision_question: Does the actual governed V2.1 product preserve grounding, authority, persistence, and bounded proactive behavior under provider-backed realistic virtual time?

hard_gates.name: bulk-stops-on-canary-failure
hard_gates.evidence: Both canaries were persisted and the remaining 818 cases were not started.

hard_gates.name: hidden-gold-remains-closed
hard_gates.evidence: No hidden-gold file was materialized or loaded.

hard_gates.name: schema-correction-accepted
hard_gates.evidence: The T1-v2 canary completed exact Terra and GPT-5.4 mini calls under the corrected schemas.

hard_gates.name: all-provider-canaries-valid
hard_gates.evidence: The T0 canary's only GPT-5.4 mini call was classified as malformed before accepted identity or usage accounting.

failures.evidence: The typed OpenAI client classified the T0 canary generation as malformed. A brief connectivity interruption cannot be excluded, but the next seven calls succeeded and unrestricted response content was not retained, so the exact transient transport/provider-output cause cannot be reconstructed.

decision.rationale: Revoke attempt 004 and make no product-quality claim. The user subsequently requested one fresh connectivity retry, frozen separately as attempt 005 without changing the evaluated method.

limitations: No provider-backed autonomy-quality conclusion is valid from this attempt.
The failed provider response was not retained; only its bounded malformed-response classification is durable, and transient connectivity cannot be confirmed or excluded.
The 820-case network-free pass remains infrastructure evidence and cannot promote T1-v2.
Attempt 005 exists only because the user explicitly superseded the prior no-third-attempt boundary after identifying possible transient connectivity.
